title: German group reproducing the effect
summary: Charles tells of German group reproducing the effect, about 2020s at Germany, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote:
>> There's another group I'm working with
in Germany who's reproducing this. So,

plain: A witness named Charles, talking on a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels in an episode about a claimed antigravity propulsion device, says he is working with another group in Germany that is reproducing the same effect sometime in the 2020s. He gives no more detail than that. If true, it would mean the claimed effect can be repeated by people other than its first builders.
